historical_reviews.deepseek: A non-empty `$PCIEID` does not prove membership in the selected System; a readable response can belong to a stale, cross-System or wrong resource type.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Its prerequisite classification and collection-to-member chain are accepted, with precise parent-membership and stable identity evidence emphasized.
historical_reviews.history: No exact-code active or invalidated review was found.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The PCIeId must originate from the selected collection and the returned `@odata.id` and resource type must close the identity loop before fields are interpreted.

original_test_intent: Read one approved PCIe member belonging to the selected ComputerSystem and validate its exact resource identity and permitted device/function metadata without changing PCIe state.
original_method: Resolve the System and firmware-supported PCIe collection, select one deterministic advertised member link, GET that exact URI once with trusted curl/jq, validate parent membership, `@odata.id`, resource type and approved identity/status fields, then export redacted evidence.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the firmware member schema and deterministic selection rule; the security owner approves which serial, address, vendor/device, slot and topology fields may be retained or redacted.
required_inputs: Firmware-specific member resource type and field schema
Trusted TLS and least-privilege credential provider
curl and jq on approved agent host
PCIe identity/topology privacy and retention policy
safety_requirements: Do not accept a free-form PCIeId
Require selected URI in the parent collection
No reset, hotplug, firmware, power or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Select exactly one approved member link
Capture status/headers and restricted raw hash
Validate `@odata.id`, PCIeId, resource type, parent membership and approved fields
Export redacted member snapshot and no-mutation audit

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The nested GET reflects member scope, but `$PCIEID` is untrusted input and the fixed `system` parent can sever provenance. It also lacks HTTP/resource-type/identity checks and privacy controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS, choose one `Members[].@odata.id` from the validated System PCIe collection, GET it unchanged, require matching returned `@odata.id`/PCIeId and approved resource type/fields, then export only redacted metadata.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The one-member PCIe GET and 15/10 timing remain; no SystemId, PCIeId, device/function type or field value is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use collection-derived member provenance and exact response identity/type validation, not caller-supplied IDs, before evaluating PCIe attributes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds trusted link ancestry, secure access, member schema/type enforcement and privacy-scoped evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates one selected member deeply; it does not establish collection completeness or full device inventory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A member may represent a device, function or OEM aggregate depending on firmware. Management inventory may not reflect live host enumeration or negotiated link state.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it preserves the original advertised member URI, parent System association, certificate binding and returned identity/type evidence. Host PCI BDF or `lspci` cannot be substituted for this Redfish member without an approved mapping.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC/System identity and firmware/schema provenance
Validated System→PCIe collection→selected member link chain
HTTP status/content type and restricted raw response hash
Matching `@odata.id`, PCIeId, resource type and parent association

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, member URI and GET consistently describe reading one PCIeId resource. DeepSeek's fixed parent and free-form ID are implementation deficiencies, not contradictory Master semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The single-member intent is explicit. Collection representation, selection rule, schema, trust, credentials and privacy policy are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Replaces an arbitrary PCIeId query with a provenance-closed member read that proves parent membership, returned identity/type and privacy-safe evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe IDs are often implementation-specific and can be reused after firmware or topology changes. Therefore a stored or operator-entered ID is insufficient; the URI must be selected from the current target System collection and the response must identify the same resource type and path. Only after closing this identity chain can vendor/device, slot or status fields be evaluated, and those fields require controlled disclosure because they reveal platform topology.
